topics.label: Introduction to the complement lecture
topics.groupedBecause: Opening remarks introduce the lecture topic and framing on the complement system.

topics.label: Foundations and central role of complement component C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts, nomenclature rules, and central biochemistry of the complement cascade centered on C3.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation and trigger threshold
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three distinct recognition pathways that initiate complement activation and converge on the C3 trigger threshold.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream effector functions through which activated complement eliminates pathogens and stimulates inflammation.

topics.label: Host cell regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory mechanisms that prevent complement activation from damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical manifestations of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the diverse clinical presentations and disease outcomes associated with deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen complement evasion strategies and applications
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how pathogens evade complement attack and how these bacterial evasion factors are utilized in biotechnology and medicine.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: Closing remarks conclude the complement lecture and preview the next topic in the series.
